0: City of Santa Claus, Georgia Ordinance (No Pit Bull or Mixed Pit Bull Breed Dogs) Be it ordained that the Councilmen, Monte Powell, Tim Horton, Vince Meadows, and Carl Joyner and the Mayor, George Al Lewis of Santa Claus, GA do hereby pass an approve a City Ordinance which states, “No Pit Bull or Mixed Pit Bull Breed Dogs are allowed within the city limits of Santa Claus, GA.”
